reason: I already open YouTube Studio every morning and I already watch the gurus for free. Another tool that reads my numbers and tells me what to post feels like one more thing to check, and I don't see what it adds beyond what the gurus already tell me.
objection: Will it tell me anything Studio doesn't already show me, or will it just repeat the numbers back to me in Hindi?
would_change_my_mind: If the first report pointed out one specific video that beat my usual views for a reason I could copy the next day, and I could see that without spending time on it.
